NARRATIVE AND PLANS
ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
FOR THE PROPERTY COMMONLY KNOWN AS 3257-59 SOUTHEMERALD AVENUE
FROM RS 3TO RT 4

Applicant seeks a Type ! Map Amendment of the City of Chicago Zoning Map from the
current RS 3 District to that of an RT 4 District for the property commonly known 3257-59
South Emerald Avenue. The site is improved with an existing two residential dwelling unit
building at 3257 South Emerald Ave. and a vacant south side yard lot. Applicant seeks to
subdivide the zoning Lot, which is 49 feet in width, into two zoning lots. The resulting
northern lot, 3257 S. Emerald Ave., will be 25 feet in width and maintain the existing two
residential dwelling unit building. The resulting southern lot, 3259 S. Emerald Ave., will be
24 feet in width. It is proposed to be improved with a two residential dwelling unit building
as part of the present zoning amendment application.

The following is a list of the proposed bulk and density of the development:
3257 SOUTH EMERALD AVENUE (all calculations are existing without proposal to alter)

Lot Area: 3,125 square feet

Density: 2 residential dwelling units (existing)
Lot Area Per Unit: 1,562.5 square feet

Off Street Parking: 2 spaces (existing)

Height: approximately 30 feet (existing)
Floor Area: approximately 2,490 square feet (existing)
Floor Area Ratio: approximately 0.8 (existing)
Front Setback: approximately 12.5 feet (existing)
Rear Setback: approximately 54.2 feet (existing)
North Side Setback: 0.03 feet (existing)*

South Side Setback: 0 feet (after subdivision)*

3259 SOUTH EMERALD AVENUE

Lot Area: 3,000 square feet

Density: 2 residential dwelling units

Lot Area Per Unit: 1,500 square feet

Off Street Parking: 2 spaces

Height: 28 feet 10 inches

Floor Area: 3,192.33 square feet

Floor Area Ratio: 1.07

Front Setback: 5 feet 6 inches*

Rear Setback: 41 feet

North Side Setback: 3 feet

South Side Setback: 8 inches

* Type | filing as per section 17-13-0303-D Optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation.
Specifically, seeking 17-13-1101-B Variation for reduced required side yards and front yard.
